system.flavor: He let the lenses settle. The city's secrets arranged themselves.

manifestation.concept: An array of small lenses — physical or summoned — that maps the hidden lines of a region. Trade routes, ley lines, social ties, surveillance.
manifestation.riskText: Other Wyrdlens, certain Pactkeepers, and any sufficiently institutional surveillance apparatus will notice.
manifestation.pathResonance: Wyrdlens Adept — the map made tactical.
manifestation.fictionalPermission: You can see a region's hidden geography. The region notices.
manifestation.gmCalibration: Tier-3 Form. Excellent for strategic phases. Loud at the strategic layer; quiet at the tactical.
manifestation.mechanicalHook: While active, allies have +2 to Investigate and Strategy rolls in the mapped region. GM provides a mental map of one hex's hidden lines: contraband routes, faction influence, ley resonance.
manifestation.signature: The lenses arrange themselves in a slow geometric pattern around a central axis you choose.
manifestation.thirdThing: Once mapped, the region knows it has been mapped. It may push back over the next session.

description.value:
Lens-Tuned Recall. Your memory has grooves worn into it by repeated passes over the same strange patterns.

  • You gain a small mechanical bonus on Occult (Mind) and Lore (Mind) checks made to recall information about Sparks, Tikkun workings, Qliphothic phenomena, or Sephirotic anomalies.
  • If you fail such a check by 5 or less, the GM may give you a partial or sideways answer instead of nothing.

"The lions are gone. The wolves are gone. The kings are gone. We're still here. Think about what that means."

Echo-Divers are the rats of the new world — and they say it with pride. A rat survives what a lion can't. A rat is already moving when the ceiling falls. A rat threads a collapsing vault without ever touching a trigger plate.

Creature Type. Humanoid (Echo-Diver). Size. Medium. Speed. 6 squares

Temporal Flinch (1/Soma Break). You experience the next two seconds as a constant, faint pre-echo. You are immune to the Surprised condition while conscious. As a reaction, when you or a creature within 2 squares of you would be hit by an attack you can see, you may move yourself or that creature 1 square — if this moves the target out of the attack's range or line, the attack misses.

Niche Survivor. You need roughly half the food, water, and air a comparable Medium creature needs. Reroll the lowest die on Body checks against suffocation, starvation, dehydration, or extreme temperature (auto-fires). You can squeeze through gaps and hold stillness that shouldn't work, and you know it.

Vault Sight. Darkvision 12 squares Reroll the lowest die on Perception checks to notice unstable structure, active traps, trigger plates, load-bearing failures, or Spark / chronoflux residue (auto-fires).

Your Echo-Diver heritage grants additional features through advancements (Temporal Afterimage, Strategic Hooks) at character creation.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Echo-Diver: Time-Sense
Recovery: 1/Soma Break (Temporal Flinch) + 3 always-on passives  ·  Action: Picker (Temporal Flinch · Niche Survivor · Vault Sight · Cannot Be Surprised)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
Click to open the 4-slot picker. Niche Survivor (Body reroll vs environment) and Vault Sight (Perception reroll vs traps/structure/Spark) auto-fire on matching rolls. Surprise immunity surfaces as a Defenses pill.

system.effect: Pull a hidden correspondence into visibility: sightlines, fault lines, symbolic likeness, the one angle from which the impossible becomes targetable.
system.flavor: Fine glass geometry threads itself through the air until the world gives up one of its secrets.

manifestation.concept: A lens-like revelation that makes concealed structure actionable.
manifestation.costText: 1 Clarity to name what kind of hidden structure you are looking for.
manifestation.durationText: Holds for one scene while the angle is observed.
manifestation.triggerText: Breaks if the seer refuses the truth it reveals.

manifestation.rangeAreaText: Sight; the angle can bridge mirrors, lenses, diagrams, and matching forms.

manifestation.thirdThing: The lens always shows one irrelevant detail so vividly that it feels accusatory.

description.value:
Bad Eden Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Echo-Diver heritage: Empyrean.

“Something is about to happen. Move.”

Echo-Diver (Empyrean). Your time-sense tilts forward. You feel weather before it arrives — not the storm outside, the storm of events. Empyrean Echo-Divers are the ones who always get out of the room five seconds before the bad thing, and can never quite explain how.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Echo-Diver).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Movement. 6 squares walking.

  • Lineage Lean. Echo-Diver does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Intrigue in fiction and through Tier powers.

Echo-Diver Core: Half-Second Inheritance

Shared across all Echo-Diver heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Temporal Flinch. You cannot be surprised while conscious. Once per scene, when you or an ally within 2 squares would be hit by an attack you can see, you can use your reaction to shift yourself or that ally 1 square If this moves the target out of the attack's range or line, the attack misses.

  • Niche Survivor. You need roughly half the food, water, and air that a comparable Medium creature needs. You reroll the lowest die on Body checks against suffocation, starvation, dehydration, and extreme temperature.

  • Vault Sight. You have low-light vision out to 12 squares You reroll the lowest die on Mind (Perception) checks to notice unstable structure, active traps, trigger plates, load-bearing failure, and temporal or Spark residue.

  • Rat Inheritance. You can squeeze through spaces at least one foot wide without halving your movement, and you can hold stillness that shouldn't work.

Empyrean Traits

  • Stratospheric Resistance. You have resistance to chemical damage with the lightning flavor, kinetic damage with the thunder flavor, and psychic damage. The sky takes its swing at you constantly. It misses.

  • Weathered. You reroll the lowest die on Mind (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or air currents. You always know which way the wind is blowing. Always.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / Bad Eden)

  • Domain Edge. Your Domain gains +20 Intrigue marks and +10 Soft Power marks at campaign start.

  • Hex Synergy. In Open Sky / Plateau / High-Altitude hexes, your Domain gains +1 initiative on all conflicts resolved in those hexes.

  • Storm Warning. Once per turn, when the GM reveals an incoming hazard or attack on your Domain, you may force the GM to disclose one additional detail about it. You saw it coming.

Tier 1 — Tarot Mage

“The future is rude. I read it anyway.”

You are not powerful yet. You are noticeable. The cards do not obey you, but they do answer — and that is already enough to make normal people uncomfortable.

Tactical (Character Scale)

  • Gain a skill rank in Insight or Occult (GM or player choice if one is already covered elsewhere)
  • 1/Soma Break, before making an attribute check, you may draw the line of fate early and gain Advantage on that check

Strategic (Faction Scale)

  • Once per turn, before a faction Intrigue-forward action, you may read the spread: gain +2 to one relevant Intrigue marks roll

Cost: once you start consulting fate, you begin seeing patterns everywhere. Expect second-guessing, omen pressure, or trouble distinguishing signal from appetite.

Recovery: 1/Soma Break  ·  Action: Free (before check)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
Before an attribute check, reroll the lowest die on it.

system.flavor: She traced the mark on her palm. The room came into focus.

manifestation.concept: A glyph etched somewhere on your body — palm, brow, sole of foot — that sharpens what you witness while you consciously focus on it.
manifestation.riskText: Some things look back through it. Sleep is occasionally interrupted.
manifestation.pathResonance: Wyrdlens Adept — perception kept always, sharpened on demand.
manifestation.fictionalPermission: Your senses are visibly enhanced. People notice you noticing.
manifestation.gmCalibration: Tier-1 Form. Other Wyrdlens see the sigil and recognize the school.
manifestation.mechanicalHook: +2 to all Insight, Notice, and Investigate rolls. Once per scene, the GM tells you one thing the sigil saw that you did not.
manifestation.signature: The sigil glows faintly when looked at directly. It is impossible to look at and not be seen by.
manifestation.thirdThing: The sigil sees a few things you do not. Sometimes it warns you. Usually too late.

description.value:
Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Magician

  • Tactical: You gain a skill rank in Occult and Lore. You learn one Tier-0 manifestation from the Wizard manifestation list.
  • Strategic: Your Domain's passive OP bias now follows the base Archetype file.

Victory - Endurance becomes momentum. +1 Violence, +1 Culture OPs

Netzach is passion that refuses extinction. It rewards morale, persistence, and the emotional drive to keep moving when a lesser faction would break or quietly go home.

system.flavor: She breathed in. The room stopped having secrets, briefly.

manifestation.concept: Perceive the entire scene at once — every speaker, every weapon, every relationship, every untold thing — for one breath.
manifestation.riskText: Stress 1 from the influx. Anyone watching you closely sees the moment your eyes change.
manifestation.pathResonance: Wyrdlens Adept — the scene legible at once.
manifestation.fictionalPermission: You know what is happening in this room. All of it. Briefly.
manifestation.gmCalibration: T2 Working. GM gives 4-7 facts. Player chooses what to act on. Other casters in the scene notice.
manifestation.mechanicalHook: GM describes the scene at a level above your current vantage: who is connected to whom, who is armed, who is lying, who is afraid, where the exits are. Allies reroll lowest die on Initiative this scene.
manifestation.signature: Your eyes briefly cloud over with a faint geometric pattern.
manifestation.thirdThing: What you see in that moment is more than your conscious mind can hold. The rest goes into dreams later.

description.value:
“You do not wave your hands and hope. You know what symbols are for.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Magician (Scholar). Researcher, operator, and wielder of applied understanding. You turn knowledge into leverage and leverage into effect.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. This Archetype is associated with +1 Intrigue in faction calculus.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for the full tactical and strategic expression of scholarship, arcane literacy, research throughput, and recovered knowledge.

attributes (Archetype ASI)

When you choose this Archetype, you gain 3 attribute points to distribute using the 2024 rules (no more than +2 to any one score). Common patterns include:

  • Ritual Savant: +2 Mind, +1 Soul
  • Arcane Operator: +2 Mind, +1 Presence
  • Library Occultist: +1 Mind, +1 Soul, +1 Presence

These are suggestions, not constraints. Any valid 3-point distribution is allowed.

manifestation.concept: Hit a target by hitting its mirror — its reflection in water, a portrait, an effigy, a shared thread. The harm transfers.
manifestation.riskText: If the surrogate is destroyed in the process, the link is gone — no further strikes against this target through this object.
manifestation.pathResonance: Wyrdlens Adept — what touches the reflection touches the thing.
manifestation.fictionalPermission: You can hurt someone you cannot see, if you can name what they are like.
manifestation.gmCalibration: T2 Working. GM may require an Insight check to find the right correspondence first. High Surge potential.
manifestation.mechanicalHook: Strike a surrogate to deal 2d6 psychic damage to the original at any range, ignoring cover and most defenses.
manifestation.signature: The mirror or surrogate cracks at the same instant the target staggers.
manifestation.thirdThing: The surrogate retains the wound permanently. Everyone who handles it after will sense it.

description.value:
Occult Association (Bad Eden): Tarot Mage.

“The future is rude. I read it anyway.”

Tarot Mages do not predict the future. They interrogate it.

They treat fate like a deck: shuffled by chaos, cut by will, and stacked by anyone reckless enough to pay the price. Where other occult traditions pursue the Great Work through doctrine, continuity, or purification, the Tarot Mage pursues it through timing. The right pressure, at the right instant, can do what a thousand sincere speeches cannot.

To a Tarot Mage, the Great Work is not just about choosing well. It is about choosing at the moment that matters.

How Tarot Mages pursue the Great Work:

  • By reading currents before Scenarios begin
  • By turning uncertainty into leverage
  • By making coincidence behave like a trained animal
  • By treating timing as a resource as real as OP

Resonance: Keter / Signal / Probability — possibility, timing, pattern emergence, and the dangerous urge to edit what has not happened yet.

Tell-tales: shuffles anything that can be shuffled — cards, choices, people.

Faction Effect (Passive):

  • +1 to Intrigue marks rolls

Cost Principle: fate does not like fingerprints. Expect backlash, strange timing, narrative inversion, and consequences that arrive sideways when you push probability too hard.

"Every structure has a flaw. You only have to look at it correctly."

The Wyrdlens Adept turns perception into force. You run on Surge like everyone, and yours arrives when you land a manifestation (bank +1, max +2/round) — every revelation feeds the lens. The free Probability Overlay (1/round reroll-lowest, refreshes at the start of your turn) stays as your innate edge.

The Lens (spent via Surge)

  • Foresight (1) — you or an ally banks a reroll-lowest (you saw the thread).
  • Expose (2) — a foe's next attack and its saves are rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2 (you read the seam).
  • Refract (3) — an ally gains DR equal to Tier and a freed reaction (harm bends aside).
  • Revelation (5) — allies within 6 squares bank a reroll; a foe's next attack is rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2.

Tikkun Sight endures — once per Soma Break, treat a misfire as a base-tier success (the Tree pays in Clarity instead).

system.flavor: He set the lantern on the table. The conversation got more careful.

manifestation.concept: A small blue flame in a lantern, candle, or palm. It burns brighter when truth is spoken near it — and dimmer when truth is avoided.
manifestation.durationText: Persistent until extinguished or moved beyond Far range.
manifestation.riskText: The flame draws witnesses. People in trouble may seek it out. People with secrets may try to put it out.
manifestation.pathResonance: Wyrdlens Adept — truth as low ambient flame.
manifestation.fictionalPermission: You can install a lie-detector in a room, leave the room, and trust the room.
manifestation.gmCalibration: Tier-2 Form. Always-on. Politically inconvenient in many settings.
manifestation.mechanicalHook: Within Near range of the flame, all Insight rolls reroll the lowest die. A liar in the same room will visibly notice the flame dim and may flinch.
manifestation.signature: The flame is silent. It is also faintly cold.
manifestation.thirdThing: When extinguished, the flame remembers the last lie told near it and carries that memory until relit.

description.value:
Tier 1 — Lens Read. You read the cracks in the world's algorithm. Your manifestation misfire band is lowered by 1 (a result that would misfire instead lands as the next-lower outcome). Once per scene, an adjacent ally borrows the reduction by spending 1 of your Clarity.

Discipline (passive): Misfire shift −1.

Strategic carryover: scenes resolved through your Refraction count as one tier of Identification already paid for the directing faction's next strategic action (GM call). Skill rank +1 in Occult and Lore.

system.flavor: She tilted her head. The mask came off.

manifestation.concept: Strip an illusion, glamour, or hidden structure off a target for one breath. Everyone present sees the thing as it actually is.
manifestation.riskText: Some things are hidden for kindness. Some things should not be looked at directly.
manifestation.fictionalPermission: You can see through it. So can everyone with you.
manifestation.gmCalibration: T1 Working. Single subject. GM reveals one truth. Player chooses which axis (identity, intent, condition, history).
manifestation.mechanicalHook: Reveal hidden truth about a person, place, or object — invisibility, disguise, lie, secret structure. Allies reroll lowest die on the next check that uses the revealed information.
manifestation.signature: A faint glass-ring tone sounds at the moment of revelation.
manifestation.thirdThing: The thing being unmasked feels it. They will know it was you.

Crew Type (Bad Eden): Covert Ops Cell.

“If you saw it happen, it wasn’t us.”

Covert Ops cells make wars quiet. They prefer locks to speeches, shadows to banners, and results to credit. They don’t start fights—they rearrange the board so the fight never happens.

  • Tactical Identity: You gain a skill rank in Stealth and with the Tinkering aptitude.
  • Strategic Identity: Your Domain starts with +1 Intrigue OPs.

The Refraction of Foresight reads time a half-second early. Your Surge spends are that edge made real: foreseen rerolls, an ally given room time shouldn't allow, and the strike that simply declines to land.

  • The Slowed Instant (2) — an ally gains a freed reaction and DR equal to Tier.
  • The Stopped Strike (5) — a foe is Staggered and its next attack is rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2.
